title: David's Last Words
description: David speaks his last words as a prophetic declaration. He calls himself the anointed one of Jacob's God and the sweet singer of Israel, stating that the Lord's Spirit has spoken through him. He describes the righteous ruler who reigns in the fear of God, like the morning light after rain, and points to the eternal covenant God made with his house. Finally, this is contrasted with the godless, who are like thorns that are thrown away and burned up.
